LESSON: OUR HOME

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.2: Our home
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our home, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you make your home environment clean and safe?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our home together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: Independence as the learner cleans furniture using suitable materials.

• Communication and Collaboration: Speaking engagingly as learners share ideas on furniture found at home.

Values:
• Responsibility: Self-drive is enhanced as the learner keeps the home environment clean such as practising cleaning

assorted home items using suitable cleaning materials.

• Social justice: Fairness is inculcated as learners share the available cleaning materials amicably.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Disaster risk reduction: Development of awareness of potentially risky areas and objects that can cause harm/accidents to

foster safety of self and others as learners identify and select places where common accidents are likely to occur.

8

Link to other Learning Areas:

Creative Arts Activities: The concept of drawing and colouring forms as learners draw and colour materials used to sweep,

wipe, dust and collect litter at home.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Furniture-table and chair, cleaning materials (soap, water, sponge, sisal fibres, piece of cloth) Adapted digital devices with

made of heavy gauge material and legible prints with appropriate colour contrast home environment, Approved learning
